hook: Doing traditional stretches before lifting weights makes your muscle fibers weaker and sabotages every single rep of your entire workout.
body: When you hold those long stretches right before your heavy sets, your nervous system actually relaxes the muscle too much. You lose explosive power, struggle to recruit maximum muscle fibers, and completely stall your strength gains. Instead, drop the static holds and switch to dynamic movements like arm circles and bodyweight squats to raise your core temperature and activate your nervous system properly.
cta: Save this for your next gym session so you never accidentally weaken your lifts again.
